metadata.title: Gagliardo--Nirenberg extremals on manifolds with small holes
metadata.abstract: We study the sharp homogeneous Dirichlet Gagliardo--Nirenberg quotient on a closed Riemannian manifold with holes of small capacity and connected complements. For each fixed exponent $2<q<2^*$, the nonnegative $L^2$-normalized extremal exists and is unique when the first Dirichlet eigenvalue $\lambda_D$ is sufficiently small. If the ambient volume is $V$ and $\beta=n(q-2)/2$, the sharp constant satisfies $C_D=V^{1-q/2}\lambda_D^{-\beta/2}(1+O(\lambda_D))$. For the normalized first eigenfunction $\varphi_D$, we obtain $\|u_D-\varphi_D\|_{H^1}=O(\lambda_D^{3/2})$ and $C_D/W_{M_D}(\varphi_D)=1+O(\lambda_D^2)$, together with a quantitative stability estimate in terms of the relative deficit. The constants depend only on the ambient manifold and the exponent. On general compact manifolds with Dirichlet boundary conditions, we prove compactness above the Euclidean sharp constant and describe concentration at equality. Positive scalar curvature at one interior point implies attainment. For the $L^2$-critical nonlinear Schrödinger energy, the mass threshold for negative energy tends to zero as the capacity of the holes tends to zero, whereas the threshold for unboundedness below is unchanged.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: 极值唯一性与渐近估计
analysis.workSummary: 研究闭流形挖去小容量洞后，齐次 Dirichlet Gagliardo–Nirenberg 商的极值、尖锐常数和稳定性。
techniques: 小 Dirichlet 特征值渐近
analysis.breakthrough: 第一特征值充分小时得到归一化非负极值的存在唯一性和定量展开，并区分临界 NLS 负能量阈值与能量无下界阈值。
analysis.limitations: 需补空间连通、固定次临界指数及小特征值条件；负能量阈值趋零不意味着能量无下界的质量阈值也改变。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

analysis.priorityReason: 把小洞几何、极值稳定与非线性阈值联系起来。
